test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

I have published many research papers.

options.text: Many research papers are published by me.
Many research papers were published by me.
Many research papers had been published by me.
Many research papers have been published by me.

solution:
Here the correct answer is **Many research papers have been published by me.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **active voice**. We need to change it into **passive voice.**
 
• The sentence is in **present perfect tense.**
 
• The **structure **of present perfect tense is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + have + V3 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + have + been + V3 + by + Subject.
 
 
 
• The subject** 'I' **becomes the object** 'me' **of the passive voice.
 
• The object** 'many research papers'** becomes the subject of the passive voice.
 
• **'have published' **is changed to **'have been published'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Passive Voice:**__ *Many research papers have been published by me.*
